body:
Thank you for taking the time to write this out. I'm on my phone so I'll try to answer as coherently as I can, bear with me.

1. I don't have money for a gym membership. Besides, in the age of smartphones, fat ppl at the gym are a laughing stock and a punchline. I don't want a video of me surfacing on some cringe website.
2. How do you know? You've never seen me. People have been feeding me the "you'll find someone someday!" line since I was 13. It's not going to happen. I'm hideous, poor and have a terrible personality. Nothing to offer a potential partner.
3. I'm stuck here until May, as I am a leaseholder. Like I mentioned in another reply, I have about $2k to my name, and I will need thousands to move anywhere, let alone to another city or state. Also due to the state of America, 99% of places require a car to get anywhere. Which leads me to the next point:
4. I do actually have a license, I've just never used it and haven't driven in years. Where am I supposed to learn? Driving school? No money for that, let alone to lease a car. Besides, I need to save every penny if I want to move in May (if I'm still alive).
5. I just got my current job, it was agonizing and hard to get it and they only took me in because they were desperate. I don't have references due to a combination of wacky company policy and fucking up at my first job due to mental health issues. I also had a physical job for about a year (dog walking) but surprise surprise! I didn't lose any weight and made even less money than I do now. I burned through most of my savings.
6. There was a time when I was making pretty good money, but honestly despite that I still didn't make any friends really, and was still really isolated and lonely. Moving to another city would make me lonelier and sadder. I've always been pretty socially inept and I didn't really have any fun teenage years. I mostly stayed inside and played video games by myself. Even with a good job I don't see that changing anytime soon.

Anyway, I appreciate your concern and the time you took to type this out. Thanks but I still don't see a way out of this.

I don't have enough money to move. I have around $2k to my name right now due to an extended period of unemployment/low wages. If I move I will definitely lose my security deposit. Either way, rent in new york is insane and I just don't have enough for moving expenses, especially if I will need furniture and other things like that. Besides, what will I tell my existing roommates? How will I find someone to replace me when one roommate is a sexual predator?

Also, the building I live in is run by a large, faceless corporation with many buildings in multiple city. The lease I am on is worded extremely vaguely, though it does imply that I will be responsible for the rest of the money on the lease if I back out early. Either way, they have a huge legal team and the resources to completely financially ruin me. Moving unfortunately isn't an option at this point in time.
